description: Live Google or Bing position (top 20) of a website for up to 10 keywords, with the ranking URL and the top 3 domains. Use to check right now where a site ranks on Google (default) or Bing (engine: bing; ChatGPT search and Copilot draw on Bing's index) for specific keywords (one country). Returns engine, ranking count and results[] {keyword, position (null when not in the top 20), url, title, top3[] domains}. Not charged when the data source fails. Price: $0.10 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails.
